items.title: Binance deposits overtake withdrawals, and the SEC creates crypto FAQs on governance
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses deposits overtaking withdrawals on Binance, North Korea denying any role in the hack, and the SEC creating 3 guides on crypto governance and token status. 

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Tesla China Brushes Off Weak October, Still Up 21% In 2026
items.summary: Tesla China sales fell 29% vs. September but rose 10% vs. a year earlier.

items.title: Tesla, Amazon, and SpaceX among companies snubbing tokenized stocks
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how Tesla (TSLA), Amazon (AMZN), SpaceX (SPCX), Netflix (NFLX), Lam Research (LRCX) and SoFi (SOFI) have opted out of a tokenized-stock offering, and why Nasdaq (^IXIC) sees tokenization as competition. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Tesla's China-Made Vehicle Sales Rise 10.3% in October
items.summary: Tesla sold 67,829 China-made vehicles in October, up 10.3% year over year.

items.title: Tesla Stocks Move Lower With Fort Worth Robotaxi Expansion in Focus
items.summary: The new service area broadens the operating footprint, while fleet economics remain undisclosed.

items.title: Applied Digital Surges 9% as AI Data Center Stocks Rebound From Financing Jitters; IREN Jumps 9%, Nebius Climbs 7%
items.summary: A CEO financing warning and an Elon Musk broadside sent AI data center stocks into a steep slide, but buyers are rushing back in today and one developer is leading the charge despite carrying more debt than it collects in rent.

items.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
items.summary: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, Lam Research, and SoFi objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 56.

items.title: CFTC Greenlights Perpetual Futures on U.S. Stocks
items.summary: Kalshi, Coinbase, and Bitnomial already have filings in, though the onshore version comes with set trading hours and far less leverage than offshore perps.
